newsitem.title: SPAIN: Montoro sees Spain Q4 growth of more than 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Montoro sees Spain Q4 growth of more than 2.5 pct.

text.p: Spain's gross domestic product will grow by more than 2.5 percent in the fourth quarter, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Friday.
"We are exceeding 2.5 percent (growth) in the fourth quarter (over the year-ago quarter) according to leading indicators," Montoro told journalists after a seminar on European monetary union.
The government's objective is GDP growth of 2.3 percent this year, and of three percent next year.
Earlier, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato told Reuters Financial Television that third-quarter growth would be between 2.3 and 2.5 percent.
